Container.Name: WindroseServer
Container.Overview:
Dockerized dedicated server for Windrose. Runs the Windows server binary under Wine on Debian.
Windrose uses a peer-to-peer networking model keyed off an Invite Code — no ports need to be forwarded or published. Players join your server by entering the Invite Code you set below.
Recommended resources: 2 players: 8 GB RAM 4 players: 12 GB RAM 10 players: 16 GB RAM Disk: ~35 GB SSD recommended
You MUST set an INVITE_CODE (6+ alphanumeric characters, case-sensitive) before starting.

Config.Name: Invite Code
Config.Description: REQUIRED. 6+ character alphanumeric invite code (case-sensitive). Players use this to join your server.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Optional password for server access. Leave blank for no password.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Validate and update server files each time the container starts.

Config.Name: Generate Settings
Config.Description: Auto-generate server configuration files on start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as. 99 = nobody (Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as. 100 = users (Unraid default).

Config.Name: P2P Proxy Address
Config.Description: Internal P2P proxy socket address. Leave as 127.0.0.1 — do not change.

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: Storage for the installed Windrose server files, world saves, and configuration. Back this up to preserve your world.
